title: phenax neilgherrensis
intro: Phenax neilgherrensis, commonly known as the "Neilgherries plant" or "Phenax", is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Urticaceae. It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, such as fever, inflammation, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, which include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Phenax neilgherrensis are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote digestion, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
